reuse.why: The tree already exports getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts (null -> 0, number, ranged midpoint) used by the UI; the diff adds a parallel getExpectedScheduleAmount instead of changing that helper.

duplication.why: Collapses four inline copies into one new function, but that function duplicates the null/number/range dispatch of the existing getScheduledAmount, and the schedule-template.ts midpoint copy is left in place.

placement.why: The new helper sits in shared/schedules.ts, the right module for the rule; the problem is that it is a second definition there.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, the helper and a test.

maintainability.why: Two similarly named amount helpers in the same file now encode different rules (worst case vs midpoint), and the UI/balance and budget-template paths still use the midpoint, a confusing split for a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (used by SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) is not changed or used; new getExpectedScheduleAmount added beside it; server/budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts is a renamed reshaping of getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch

one_place.where: Rule changed in new getExpectedScheduleAmount (forecast, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) but not in getScheduledAmount (desktop-client consumers) nor in budget/schedule-template.ts, which still use the midpoint
